adapt.name: ADAPt
adapt.desc: Convert all of your bonus attack damage into ability power at a rate of 1 ability power per 0.6 bonus attack damage. Additionally, increase your ability power by 15%.

adamant.name: Adamant
adamant.desc:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants 10 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 100 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers (5 second cooldown per cast instance).

This augment is currently disabled.

adaptiveward.name: Adaptive Ward
adaptiveward.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to grant you 7 – 12 (based on level) bonus armor or bonus magic resistance for 6 seconds when it hits an enemy champion (4 second cooldown). This effect can stack up to a number of times.

The resistance type granted is based on the target's adaptive type: bonus armor for physical and bonus magic resistance for magic.

allforyou.name: All For You
allforyou.desc: Your heals and shields on allied champions are increased in effectiveness by 30%.

apexinventor.name: Apex Inventor
apexinventor.desc:
Grants 100 item haste, which is equivalent to 50% cooldown reduction for items.

arcaneaxiom.name: Arcane Axiom
arcaneaxiom.desc: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them refunds 15% – 30% (based on level) of your ultimate ability's total cooldown.

archmage.name: Archmage
archmage.desc: Whenever you cast an ability, refund the cooldown of another, randomly selected ability by 30% of the casted ability's cooldown.

armoredimpact.name: Armored Impact
armoredimpact.desc: After casting an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds is empowered to deal 50 – 125 (based on level) (+ 250% bonus armor) bonus physical damage to the target and surrounding enemies.

bees.name: BEES!!!
bees.desc: Hitting an enemy champion with an ability causes you to toss a beehive at them, which upon arrival explodes in a 425 radius to swarm enemy champions hit with bees for 2 seconds (15 – 10 (based on level) second cooldown). While being swarmed, targets are dealt「 75 – 200 (based on level) (+ 150% bonus AD) (+ 70% AP) magic damage 」「 18.75 – 50 (based on level) (+ 37.5% bonus AD) (+ 17.5% AP) magic damage every 0.5 seconds 」over the duration, applied on-hit effects at 40% effectiveness every 0.5 seconds (4 times total), and are slowed by 20%.

bonk.name: BONK!
bonk.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an empowered basic attack effect, further enhancing the attack to deal 30% increased damage to the target and 30% of its damage to nearby enemies.

backtobasics.name: Back to Basics
backtobasics.desc: Your champion abilities deal 35% increased damage and you gain 70 ability haste and 35% increased healing and shielding from all sources, but your ultimate ability is permanently sealed.

bigbrain.name: Big Brain
bigbrain.desc: Gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 300% AP and lasts until destroyed. Shield is replenished upon respawn and every 70 seconds.

bigshot.name: Big Shot
bigshot.desc: Convert 75% of your total attack speed into critical strike damage, at a rate of 0.67% critical strike damage per 1% attack speed. Additionally, you gain 25% bonus attack damage and 35% critical strike damage.

biggestsnowballever.name: Biggest Snowball Ever
biggestsnowballever.desc:
Upgrades your Mark into a massive snowball, empowering it with an increased size radius and the ability to pass through non-champions. The snowball additionally explodes upon impact of the target hit to deal 200 – 350 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies, knock them up for 0.75 seconds, and slow them by 20% for 2 seconds. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark. Non-champions hit by the snowball are stunned for 1.25 seconds.

bladewaltz.name: Blade Waltz
bladewaltz.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Blade Waltz.

Blade Waltz: Blink to the target enemy champion. You then blink to the nearest other enemy champion every 0.25 seconds over the next 1.75 seconds, blinking up to 7 additional times. The last blink targets the primary target. Each time you blink to an enemy, deal 30 – 150 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) physical damage to them and apply on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness, up to a total of 180 – 900 (based on level) (+ 60% bonus AD) (+ 36% AP) (45 second cooldown).

While Blade Waltz is active, you are untargetable and unable to act. This effect will end prematurely if there are no longer any nearby valid targets to blink to. An enemy can be blinked to more than once if there are no other valid targets in range.

bluebarrier.name: Blue Barrier
bluebarrier.desc: Gain a shield equal to 200% – 450% (based on level) of mana spent for 1.5 seconds. Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields. Each shield instance is capped at a strength of 300 – 800 (based on level).

bolstered.name: Bolstered
bolstered.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a shield effect, increasing the strength of the ability's shield by 0% – 60% (based on target's missing health).

bouncingbees.name: Bouncing Bees
bouncingbees.desc:
After casting an ability, your next basic attack is empowered to bounce a bee from the primary target to the nearest enemy champion within 700 units of them, dealing 50% – 100% (based on level) of the triggering attack's damage upon arrival.

Additionally, you are assigned with quests that require you to bounce bees onto enemy champions a number of times. There are three quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with bonus attack damage and an additional bee bounce on the empowered attack that repeats from the new target with each bounce, forming a chain of bee attacks.

Tier

Quest

Reward

1

Bounce bees onto enemy champions 10 times.

Gain 30 bonus attack damage and an additional bee bounce.
(2 bounces total)

2

Bounce bees onto enemy champions 30 more times (40 bounces total).

Gain 30 bonus attack damage and an additional bee bounce.
(total 60 bonus attack damage and 3 bounces)

3

Bounce bees onto enemy champions 123 more times (163 bounces total).

Gain 30 bonus attack damage and an additional bee bounce.
(total 90 bonus attack damage and 4 bounces)

brassblast.name: Brass Blast
brassblast.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Brass Blast.

Brass Blast - Active: You summon a large trumpet in front of you and begin charging for a minimum of 0.25 seconds and up to 2.5 seconds to increase Brass Blast's range, damage, and knock back distance over the first 1.5 seconds of the channel. While charging, you are slowed by 10% and can reactivate the spell. The recast occurs automatically if the charge reaches its maximum duration or is interrupted.

Recast: After a 0.5-second delay, blow into the trumpet, unleashing a blast of sound in a cone in the target direction that deals between 120 – 140 (based on level) (+ 70% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP) to 200 – 600 (based on level) (+ 115% bonus AD) (+ 80% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and knocks them back up to 500 units over 0.75 seconds.

If the charge is interrupted, 50% of the cooldown is refunded.

Brass Blast uses quick casting by default, which requires the active to be held and the recast to occur on release.

The cone has an initial radius of 700 units.

Knock back speed is 1300.

breadandbutter.name: Bread And Butter
breadandbutter.desc: Your champion's first basic ability (Q) gains 100 ability haste.

breadandcheese.name: Bread And Cheese
breadandcheese.desc: Your champion's third basic ability (E) gains 100 ability haste.

breadandjam.name: Bread And Jam
breadandjam.desc: Your champion's second basic ability (W) gains 100 ability haste.

crimsoncobalt.name: CRIMSON COBALT
crimsoncobalt.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering it to mark enemy champions damaged for 4 seconds. Your next basic attack against a marked target consumes the mark to deal 100 – 250 (based on level) (+ 70% bonus AD) (+ 35% AP) bonus magic damage and reduce the upgraded ability's current cooldown by 65% of its total cooldown.

can'ttouchthis.name: Can't Touch This
can'ttouchthis.desc: Casting your ultimate grants you invulnerability for 2 seconds (8 second cooldown).

celestialbody.name: Celestial Body
celestialbody.desc: Gain 1500 bonus health, but reduce your damage output by 10%.

chainreaction.name: Chain Reaction
chainreaction.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a knock back effect, empowering the ability to trigger a chain reaction effect when displaced champions hit other champions or terrain within 200 units. If a knocked back champion collides with another enemy champion during their displacement, the champions they collided with are dealt 100 – 400 (based on level) magic damage and knocked up for 0.5 seconds. If they collide with terrain during their displacement, they will rebound to take 150 – 800 (based on level) magic damage and become knocked up for 0.75 seconds and stunned for 0.5 seconds. The knock up duration is increased to up to 1.1 seconds based on how long the ability's cooldown is.

If the upgraded ability is an ultimate, this effect deals 250% damage, increasing the champion collision damage to 250 – 1000 (based on level) and the terrain collision damage to 375 – 2000 (based on level).

circleofdeath.name: Circle of Death
circleofdeath.desc: Healing and health regeneration you do causes you to deal 70% of that value in magic damage to the nearest enemy champion within 1000 units.

clowncollege.name: Clown College
clowncollege.desc:
Gain Shaco's Backstab, Deceive and Hallucinate's explosion. Replace a summoner spell with Deceive.

Passive - Backstab: Your basic attacks deal 20 – 35 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 35% AP) bonus physical damage on-hit when hitting an enemy from behind.

Active - Deceive: Become invisible for up to 3 seconds and blink to the target location within 400 units after a 0.125-second delay. Your next basic attack while in stealth deals 100 (+ 150% bonus AD) (+ 55% AP) bonus physical damage, increased to「 155 (+ 232.5% bonus AD) (+ 85.25% AP) bonus physical damage 」「 155% damage 」if Backstab was applied (45 second cooldown).

Passive - Hallucinate Death: Upon your death, release an explosion in a 350 radius of your death location, dealing true damage equal to 25% of target's maximum health to enemies within the area. Additionally, you deploy a box at the location of your death that instantly fears nearby enemies for 1 second. This box does not attack but lasts for 3 seconds.

courageofthecolossus.name: Courage of the Colossus
courageofthecolossus.desc: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants a shield for 3 seconds that absorbs 150 – 450 (based on level) (+ 4% maximum health) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields.

criticalhealing.name: Critical Healing
criticalhealing.desc: Your heals and shields now have a chance equal to your critical strike chance to increase in effectiveness by 40% (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

criticalrhythm.name: Critical Rhythm
criticalrhythm.desc: Your critical strikes grant you 6% bonus attack speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 60%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

cruelty.name: Cruelty
cruelty.desc:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion summons a comet above them that lands at their current location after 1 second, dealing 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% AP) (+ 4% of your maximum health) magic damage to enemies within a 300 radius (6 second cooldown per cast instance).

For displacement effects, the comet will be summoned at the displacement's end location.

dashing.name: Dashing
dashing.desc:
Abilities with dashes or blinks gain 175 ability haste.

On Kalista, this augment instead grants her 125% bonus attack speed.[1]

dawnbringer'sresolve.name: Dawnbringer's Resolve
dawnbringer'sresolve.desc:
Upon dropping below 50% maximum health, you are healed for「 30% of your maximum health 」「 2.5% of your maximum health every 0.25 seconds 」over 3 seconds (45 second cooldown, reset upon death).

This effect will still trigger if damage is taken while below 50% maximum health.

devilonyourshoulder.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
devilonyourshoulder.desc:
Forge a pact with Little Devil Teemo, who drains 0.5% of your current health every second, increased to 5% if there are enemy champions within 1000 units. In return, you deal 20% bonus true damage and your basic attacks and abilities summon a Life Remnant nearby for 5 seconds (0.75-second spawn cooldown). You can absorb a Life Remnant by moving over it, healing you for 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP) and granting you 15% bonus movement speed.

This augment is currently disabled.

divebomber.name: Dive Bomber
divebomber.desc: Upon death, you explode to deal true damage equal to 20% of the target's maximum health to enemies within 500 units.

divineintervention.name: Divine Intervention
divineintervention.desc: Automatically cast Taric's Cosmic Radiance, calling down a protective star upon you that descends over 2.5 seconds. Afterwards, you and all allied champions within 400 units become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).

don'tblink.name: Don't Blink
don'tblink.desc: Deal 1% increased damage per 10 movement speed you have more than the target.

don'tchangethechannel.name: Don't Change the Channel
don'tchangethechannel.desc: For every second that you channel an ability, you gain a 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 50% AD) (+ 25% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield. The shield quickly decays once you stop channeling.

doublestrike.name: Double Strike
doublestrike.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an empowered basic attack effect, further enhancing the attack to apply on-hit effects to targets it hits a second time.

This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

doubletap.name: Double Tap
doubletap.desc: Basic attacks that critically strike apply on-hit effects an additional time. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

doubletime.name: Double Time
doubletime.desc: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with two separate abilities within 4 seconds causes the second ability to deal bonus magic damage equal to 10% maximum mana and permanently increase your maximum mana by 25 (4 second cooldown per target).

drawyoursword.name: Draw Your Sword
drawyoursword.desc:
Become melee, modifying your attack range to 200 (+ 100% bonus attack range from augments) units. Additionally, gain 24% bonus attack damage, 20% bonus attack speed, 24% bonus health, 20% bonus movement speed, and 20% life steal. These bonuses are increased by 0% – 100% (based on champion's default attack range).

This augment is only available for ranged champions.

This augment is not offered if the champion has built Runaan's Hurricane.

dualwield.name: Dual Wield
dualwield.desc: Your basic attacks launch a bolt at the target that fires after a 0.225-second delay on-attack, deals 40% of the triggering attack's pre-mitigation damage, and applies on-hit effects at 40% effectiveness. Additionally, increase your total attack speed by 10%.

earthwake.name: Earthwake
earthwake.desc:
Dashing or blinking causes you to leave behind a trail from the location you moved to your destination that detonates after 0.75 seconds in a 300 radius, dealing 90 – 250 (based on level) (+ 125% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) physical damage per explosion to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against minions. Enemies can be affected only once every second from all cast instances, and the effect is not triggered if you move beyond 2000 units with the dash or blink.

This augment is only offered to up to 2 players on each team for a given game.

echocast.name: Echo Cast
echocast.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to summon a clone of your champion that is untargetable and moves up to 500 units towards your cursor. The clone then casts the ability it was summoned from after a 0.25-second delay, mimicking the active effects of the casted spell and disappearing after it finishes casting.

Clone movement speed is 1000.

Clone has a maximum lifetime of 7 seconds.

empoweredbythefaithful.name: Empowered By The Faithful
empoweredbythefaithful.desc: Granting a heal or shield to an allied champion blesses them for 8 seconds. Whenever a blessed ally damages an enemy champion, you generate a stack of Devotion, stacking up to 50 times. Upon reaching maximum stacks, you unleash a shockwave that expands from your location in a massive radius and deals 50 – 300 (based on level) (+ 750% heal and shield power) magic damage to enemies hit. Enemy champions damaged below a percentage of their maximum health equal to 25% of your heal and shield power are executed.

empyreanpromise.name: Empyrean Promise
empyreanpromise.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Empyrean Promise's Vigilance active. Additionally, gain 15% heal and shield power.

Active - Vigilance: After a 0.25-second delay, dash to the current location of the target allied champion and gain a 100 – 250 (based on level) (+ 100% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield for 3 seconds. Upon arrival, grant the ally the same shield (20 second cooldown; 2000 range).

enpassant.name: En Passant
enpassant.desc:
You can now identify the Vitals of enemy champions within 2000 units, marked as an arc around them and pointing towards a specific direction. Dealing damage to a target with a basic attack or ability while you are facing in the direction of their exposed Vital will consume it, dealing bonus true damage equal to 6% (+ 1.5% per En Passant stack) of the target's maximum health, healing you for 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 5% missing health), and granting you 50% (+ 5% per En Passant stack) bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. Consuming a target's Vital also grants you an En Passant stack for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent Vital triggers and stacking up a number of times. Each En Passant stack increases the consumed Vital damage and bonus movement speed.

Vitals on targets become exposed instantly once you are within range and remain exposed until you die. Once a target's Vital is consumed, you identify a new Vital on them pointing in a different direction from the previous after 4 seconds.

enchantingbutterflies.name: Enchanting Butterflies
enchantingbutterflies.desc:
Healing or shielding an allied champion causes a Butterfly to gather around you, up to 7. After collecting 7 Butterflies, your next instance of damage against an enemy champion fires all of your Butterflies at them, with the first one dealing 50 – 100 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) (+ 1% bonus health) (+ 3 per 1% heal and shield power) magic damage and all subsequent Butterflies dealing「 75% damage, 」「 37.5 – 75 (based on level) (+ 7.5% AP) (+ 0.75% bonus health) (+ 2.25 per 1% heal and shield power) magic damage, 」for a total damage of 275 – 550 (based on level) (+ 55% AP) (+ 5.5% bonus health) (+ 16.5 per 1% heal and shield power).

The Butteflies will orbit in a 150 radius around you.

endlessdecimation.name: Endless Decimation
endlessdecimation.desc: While in combat, automatically cast an improved version of Darius' Decimate, winding up over 1.25 seconds to slash in a 460 radius around you. The slash deals 100 – 400 (based on level) (+ 60% AD) (+ 40% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown). Enemies within the 240 inner radius of the slash take「 50% damage. 」「 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 30% AD) (+ 20% AP) physical damage. 」Additionally, for each enemy champion hit along the outer edge, you heal for 18% of your missing health and the cooldown of this effect is reduced by 10%, down to a minimum of 3 seconds.

erosion.name: Erosion
erosion.desc: Each instance of damage dealt to an enemy reduces their armor and magic resistance by 1.5% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20 times for a total of 30% resistances reduction.

escapade.name: EscAPADe
escapade.desc: Convert all of your ability power into bonus attack damage at a rate of 1 bonus attack damage per 1.66 ability power. Additionally, increase your total attack damage by 15%.

escapeplan.name: Escape Plan
escapeplan.desc:
Upon dropping below 35% maximum health, gain a shield for 65% of your maximum health for 5.5 seconds, during which you also gain 150% bonus movement speed and have reduced size (75 second cooldown). The shield and bonus movement speed decay over the duration.

This effect will still trigger if damage is taken while below 35% maximum health.

etherealweapon.name: Ethereal Weapon
etherealweapon.desc: Your abilities apply on-hit effects (1 second cooldown per target).

eureka.name: Eureka
eureka.desc: Gain ability haste equal to 30% AP.

feymagic.name: Fey Magic
feymagic.desc: Damaging enemies with your ultimate ability polymorphs them into harmless critters for 2 seconds, during which their base movement speed is reduced by 60, and disarms them for the same duration (15 second cooldown per target).

finalform.name: Final Form
finalform.desc: Casting your ultimate ability empowers you for 10 seconds, causing you to gain a shield for 50% of your maximum health, 20% omnivamp, and 30% bonus movement speed for the duration (20 second cooldown).

firebrand.name: Firebrand
firebrand.desc: Basic attacks apply a Burn for 5 seconds that deals bonus magic damage equal to「 0.4% of the target's maximum health per second. 」「 2% of the target's maximum health over the duration. 」This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

firefox.name: Firefox
firefox.desc: Automatically cast a modified version of Ahri's Fox-Fire, gaining 25% bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds and conjuring 3 flames that orbit you clockwise for up to 2.5 seconds at a radius of 150 units. The flames will fly toward the nearest visible enemies within 550 units, dealing 35 – 160 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD (+ 25% AP) adaptive damage, reduced to「 10.5 – 48 (based on level) (+ 7.5% bonus AD (+ 7.5% AP) 」「 30% of the original damage 」for enemies hit by subsequent flames from the same cast (7 second cooldown).

flash2.name: Flash 2
flash2.desc: Replace a summoner spell with Flash. Additionally, gain 70 summoner spell haste.

flashbang.name: Flashbang
flashbang.desc:
Using Flash creates an explosion around the blink location that deals 70 – 240 (based on level) (+ 70% AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 35% for 1.25 seconds. Additionally, the cooldown of your Flash resets upon your death.

This augment cannot be rolled unless you have the Flashy augment. If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.

flashy.name: Flashy
flashy.desc:
Your Flash now has 3 charges with a 2-second cooldown between casts (120 seconds recharge time for all 3 charges).

If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.

flowofspirit.name: Flow of Spirit
flowofspirit.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering its cast to grant you 60% – 120% (based on level) bonus attack speed for 4 seconds.

forgedbythemaster.name: Forged By The Master
forgedbythemaster.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your item effects and augments by 45%.

frombeginningtoend.name: From Beginning to End
frombeginningtoend.desc:
Gain the Dark Harvest and First Strike keystone runes.

Dark Harvest

Base damage changed to 50 – 100 (based on level).

Damage per soul changed to 20.

Bonus AD ratio changed to 35% bonus AD.

AP ratio changed to 25% AP.

Gain 8 Souls if this is not your first augment.

First Strike

Base gold increased to 20 from 15 (ARAM override value).

Bonus damage increased to 10% from 7%.

fromdowntown.name: From Downtown
fromdowntown.desc:
Quest: Hit enemy champions with abilities while located at least 600 units away from them (at the time of the hit) 15 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, hitting enemy champions with abilities while located at least 600 units away from them at the time of the hit fires a meteor to their current location, which upon landing deals 75 – 200 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown per target per cast instance). The meteor's damage and radius are increased based on your distance to the target at the time of the ability hit, increasing its damage by 0% – 230% and setting its radius to 150 – 1708.6 units.

Maximum meteor damage is 172.5 – 460 (based on level) (+ 115% bonus AD) (+ 46% AP).

fruitify.name: Fruitify
fruitify.desc: Enemy champions that you score a takedown against drop 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 (based on level) Honeyfruit at the location of their death for 10 seconds. You and allied champions can step over a Honeyfruit to consume it, healing for 6% of maximum health and restoring 6% of maximum mana as well as 10 energy and Fury (if applicable).

getexcited.name: Get Excited
getexcited.desc: Scoring a champion takedown grants you 100% bonus movement speed and 15% total attack speed for 4 seconds.

getjinxed.name: Get Jinxed
getjinxed.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Get Jinxed!.

Get Jinxed!: Summon a rocket from beneath you that immediately winds up over 1.5 seconds. Afterwards, it propels forward in the direction you targeted at the time of cast, causing you to ride the rocket for up to 15 seconds. The rocket automatically navigates your movement along the way and you are able to steer its trajectory in the direction of your cursor, with a slow turn rate that increases over time. After being in flight for 2 seconds, the rocket decelerates to a very slow speed for 0.6 seconds before receiving a massive boost in speed, maintaining its increased speed for the remainder of the flight.

Upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain, the rocket explodes in a 400 radius, ending the ride and dealing 20 – 80 (based on level) (+ 12% bonus AD) (+ 8% AP) (+ 3% of target's missing health) physical damage to enemies hit (including turrets). This damage is increased by 0% – 700% (based on distance the rocket travelled), up to 160 – 640 (based on level) (+ 96% bonus AD) (+ 64% AP) (+ 24% of target's missing health) physical damage.

During the initial windup and while riding the rocket, you become ghosted and are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act.

The rocket has a collision radius of 50 units on terrain and 150 units against champions.

Once propelled, the rocket travels at an initial speed of 250 for the first 0.5 seconds, before accelerating to 750. After another 1.5 seconds, it decelerates to a near halt at a speed of 50 for 0.6 seconds, then instantly accelerates to 1400 for the remainder of its flight.

giantslayer.name: Giant Slayer
giantslayer.desc: Become tiny, reducing your size by 75% and granting you 20% bonus movement speed. Additionally, deal 10% / 15% / 25% / 30% (based on target's size) bonus damage against enemy champions with greater size than you.

giftofthedrowned.name: Gift of the Drowned
giftofthedrowned.desc: Convert all of your bonus health into lethality at a rate of「 0.05 lethality per 1 bonus health. 」「 5 lethality per 100 bonus health. 」Additionally, gain 10 – 25 (based on level) lethality.

glasscannon.name: Glass Cannon
glasscannon.desc: You gain a health threshold equal to 70% maximum health which cannot be modified nor exceeded by any means. In return, you deal bonus true damage equal to ( 25% / 15%) of all of the damage you deal pre-mitigation.

goldrend.name: Goldrend
goldrend.desc: Damaging basic attacks or abilities against enemy champions deal 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage, and grant you 30 and 25% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds (30 second cooldown per champion).

goliath.name: Goliath
goliath.desc: Grants 35% bonus health, 15% adaptive force, and 50% increased size.

grouphug.name: Group Hug
grouphug.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that can target allied champions and has a heal or shield effect, empowering the ability's cast to also target two of the closest allied champions within 500 units of the primary target.

growthspurt.name: Growth Spurt
growthspurt.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Growth Spurt.

Growth Spurt: Enlarge yourself, causing you to knock up enemies within 400 units for 1 second. For the next 7 seconds, you gain 300 (+ 20% maximum health) bonus health and 50% increased size.

guiltypleasure.name: Guilty Pleasure
guiltypleasure.desc: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion heals you for 30 – 250 (based on level) (+ 1.5% maximum health) (5 second cooldown per cast instance).

handofbaron.name: Hand of Baron
handofbaron.desc: Gain a modified Hand of Baron, which only grants 25% increased adaptive force and greatly empowers nearby allied minions.

handsoffthetalent.name: Hands off the Talent
handsoffthetalent.desc: Basic attacks against enemies hit farther than 75% of your total attack range deal 15% bonus AD (+ 20% AP) bonus physical damage.

heavyhitter.name: Heavy Hitter
heavyhitter.desc: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 3.5% of your maximum health.

heavyisthecrown.name: Heavy Is The Crown
heavyisthecrown.desc:
Your total movement speed is now reduced by 5% after 1.5 seconds of entering combat. In return, you gain 10 bonus attack damage and 25 ability power, and your bonus attack damage, ability power, and total attack speed are increased by 10%. The movement speed reduction is removed after 7 seconds of being out of combat.

Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion generates a stack of Burden. For each stack, the bonus attack damage, ability power, and total attack speed are increased by 5%, and the total movement speed reduction is increased by 2.5%. The movement speed reduction is capped at 50%. Lose 50% of stacks on death.

hellbent.name: Hellbent
hellbent.desc:
Generate a stack of Revivemaxxing for each enemy champion you hit with basic attacks on-hit or abilities, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 10 times. At maximum stacks, you become Hellbent.

Hellbent: Upon taking lethal damage, you enter resurrection for 4 seconds, during which you are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act. Afterwards, you revive with 35% – 75% (based on level) of your maximum health (90 second cooldown). Additionally, you become empowered for the next 15 seconds, granting you 15 – 120 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 25 – 200 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive), 20% – 40% (based on level) bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby enemy champions, and 15% – 30% (based on level) omnivamp for the duration.

hextechsoul.name: Hextech Soul
hextechsoul.desc: Grants the Hextech Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

holysnowball.name: Holy Snowball
holysnowball.desc:
After using the Dash spell from Mark, you become invulnerable for 1.5 seconds upon arrival. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

homeguard.name: Homeguard
homeguard.desc: Gain 100% bonus movement speed. This bonus is lost for 6 seconds after taking damage.

icecold.name: Ice Cold
icecold.desc: Your slowing effects reduce the movement speed of targets by an additional 75.

impassable.name: Impassable
impassable.desc:
Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment keystone runes.

Aftershock

Cooldown reduced to 15 seconds from 20.

Glacial Augment

Cooldown reduced to 15 seconds from 25.

infernalconduit.name: Infernal Conduit
infernalconduit.desc:
Your ability hits against champions apply a Burn for 3 seconds that deals「 2 – 20 (based on level) (+ 4.6% bonus AD) (+ 2% AP) bonus magic damage per second 」「 6 – 60 (based on level) (+ 14% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) bonus magic damage over the duration 」(1 second cooldown per cast instance). This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

Additionally, all of your Burn effects reduce the cooldowns of all your basic abilities by 0.08 seconds for each tick of damage they deal to a target.

Damage over time effects from all sources except items count as Burn sources for triggering the cooldown reduction.

Eligible Augments for Burn: Firebrand, Infernal Conduit, Pressure Cooker

infernalsoul.name: Infernal Soul
infernalsoul.desc: Grants the Infernal Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

infiniterecursion.name: Infinite Recursion
infiniterecursion.desc: Gain 60 ability haste, increased by 3 each time you score a champion takedown.

it'sgotime.name: It's Go Time
it'sgotime.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, empowering the ability to grant 25% – 45% (based on level) bonus movement speed for the effect's duration.

it'skillingtime.name: It's Killing Time
it'skillingtime.desc: Upon casting your ultimate ability, you apply Zed's Death Mark to all enemy champions (8 second cooldown). The mark stores 40% of all post-mitigation damage you deal to the affected target, detonating after 5 seconds to deal true damage equal to the damage stored against them.

jeweledbracelet.name: Jeweled Bracelet
jeweledbracelet.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering its damage to be able to critically strike for (145% + bonus critical strike damage) damage. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

jeweledgauntlet.name: Jeweled Gauntlet
jeweledgauntlet.desc:
Your abilities can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical strike damage) damage. Additionally, gain 25% (+ 4.5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance.

If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).

The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects.

juiced.name: Juiced
juiced.desc: Basic attacks against enemy champions deal bonus magic damage on-hit equal to ( 7% / 5.6%) of your maximum mana. This damage can critically strike for (100% + 30%) bonus damage.

killsecured.name: Kill Secured
killsecured.desc: Gain 60% bonus movement speed towards enemy champions below 40% of their maximum health.

kingme.name: King Me
kingme.desc:
Upon entering the enemy team's gate or Catapult for the first time, either of which are located near their spawn, you become Kinged, causing you to gain one random Prismatic-tier augment and the first eligible Legendary item in your inventory to be upgraded with improved stats. The gold value of all upgradeable stats on the item is increased by exactly 1000.

King Me scans each item slot in the champion's inventory (from slots 1-6) for an eligible Legendary item, upgrading the first eligible item that is found.

legday.name: Leg Day
legday.desc: Gain 50 bonus movement speed and 50% slow resist.

light'emup.name: Light 'em Up!
light'emup.desc: Basic attacks generate a stack, up to 4. The fourth stack consumes them all to quickly launch 4 missiles at the target that each deal 11 – 80 (based on level) (+ 35% bonus AD) (+ 19% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit, for a total of 44 – 320 (based on level) (+ 140% bonus AD) (+ 76% AP).

lil'extrahelp.name: Lil' Extra Help
lil'extrahelp.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an effect which empowers your basic attacks for a duration, further enhancing the attacks by granting you ( 150 / 100) bonus attack range and ( 75% / 40%) bonus attack speed while the effect is active.

lonelywarrior.name: Lonely Warrior
lonelywarrior.desc: For each enemy champion within 600 units of you, gain 15% bonus attack speed and 10 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance.

madscientist.name: Mad Scientist
madscientist.desc: Upon acquiring this augment and each time you respawn, gain either 30% adaptive force, 20% bonus health, and 40% increased size or 70 ability haste, 40% bonus movement speed, and 40% reduced size.

magicmissile.name: Magic Missile
magicmissile.desc: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with an ability fires 3 missiles at them that each deal true damage equal to 0.33% of the target's maximum health, increased to up to 1% based on distance travelled (maximum damage reached at 1000 units). This effect can only trigger once every 6 seconds from the same cast.

marksmage.name: Marksmage
marksmage.desc: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 75% AP.

masterofduality.name: Master of Duality
masterofduality.desc: Basic attacks on-hit grant 6 – 18 (based on level) ability power and damaging abilities once per cast instance grant 3 – 9 (based on level) bonus attack damage, lasting for 5 seconds, with the duration of both refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking infinitely.

mercy'sstrike.name: Mercy's Strike
mercy'sstrike.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to enhance your next basic attack. The enhanced attack has 300 bonus range, gains 75% bonus attack speed, and deals bonus magic damage equal to 3% (+ 2% per 10% heal and shield power) of the target's maximum health. If the target is a turret, the damage is modified to 2.5% of the target's maximum health bonus magic damage.

mightyshield.name: Mighty Shield
mightyshield.desc: Gain 40 – 100 (based on level) adaptive force for 3 seconds upon gaining a shield (5 second cooldown).

mindtomatter.name: Mind to Matter
mindtomatter.desc:
Grants bonus health equal to 50% maximum mana.

Maximum bonus health granted by this effect is capped at 99,999 bonus health.

minionmancer.name: Minionmancer
minionmancer.desc: Your pets deal 40% increased damage as well as gain 40% bonus health and size.

moshmonster.name: Mosh Monster
moshmonster.desc: Casting your ultimate ability grants you 300 – 750 (based on level) bonus health on-cast and slows enemies within 350 units of you by 50% while it is active. Additionally, scoring a takedown against an enemy champion permanently increases the bonus health gained by 15 – 30 (based on level) and expands the radius of the slow, tripled if the takedown was scored while your ultimate was active.

mountainsoul.name: Mountain Soul
mountainsoul.desc: Grants the Mountain Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

multishot.name: Multishot
multishot.desc:
Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability's missile a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are six quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with an additional missile fired on the ability's cast. The reward effect also modifies the ability to fire all of its missiles in a cone. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

Hit requirements as denoted below are rounded down to whole numbers, with a minimum value of 1.

Tier

Quest

Reward

1

Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (50 ÷ Ability's Base CD) times.

Ability fires an additional missile.
(2 missiles total)

2

Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (250 ÷ Ability's Base CD) more times.

Ability fires an additional missile.
(3 missiles total)

3

Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (700 ÷ Ability's Base CD) more times.

Ability fires an additional missile.
(4 missiles total)

4

Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (2000 ÷ Ability's Base CD) more times.

Ability fires an additional missile.
(5 missiles total)

5

Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (4000 ÷ Ability's Base CD) more times.

Ability fires an additional missile.
(6 missiles total)

6

Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (8000 ÷ Ability's Base CD) more times.

Ability fires an additional missile.
(7 missiles total)

mysticpunch.name: Mystic Punch
mysticpunch.desc: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the remaining cooldowns of your abilities by 1.25 seconds.

natureishealing.name: Nature is Healing
natureishealing.desc: Upon entering a patch of brush, you are healed for「 40 – 300 (based on level) (+ 15% of your missing health) 」「 6.67 – 50 (based on level) (+ 2.5% of your missing health) every 0.25 seconds 」over 1.5 seconds (20 second cooldown per brush patch).

nightstalking.name: Nightstalking
nightstalking.desc: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them renders you invisible for 1.5 seconds, during which you also gain 40% bonus movement speed. Attacking or casting abilites ends the stealth immediately.

nomananoproblem.name: No Mana, No Problem
nomananoproblem.desc: Convert all of the mana you gain from items into ability power at a rate of 0.8 ability power per 10 mana from items. Additionally, increase your ability power by 15%.

okboomerang.name: OK Boomerang
okboomerang.desc: Automatically cast an improved version of Sivir's Boomerang Blade at the closest nearby enemy champion within 1250 units, dealing 40 – 200 (based on level) (+ 30% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) adaptive damage to enemies hit (10 second cooldown).

oceansoul.name: Ocean Soul
oceansoul.desc: Grants the Ocean Dragon Soul, which has a modified base heal value of 100, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

ominouspact.name: Ominous Pact
ominouspact.desc: Your abilities now have a health cost of 5% current health to cast them. In return, you gain ability power based on your missing health, up to 75 – 150 (based on level) at 70% missing health, 0% – 50% (based on missing health) bonus movement speed, and 0% – 20% (based on missing health) omnivamp.

outlaw'sgrit.name: Outlaw's Grit
outlaw'sgrit.desc: Dashing or blinking grants 12 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 15 seconds, stacking up to 5 times for a total of 60 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers.

overextender.name: Overextender
overextender.desc:
Your launch with the Cannon Launcher is now empowered, increasing the launch range by 12,000 units and the impact damage by 50%, as well as the travel speed by a significant amount. Additionally, your Recall is now functional and is upgraded to Empowered Recall.

This augment is only available on the Butcher's Bridge map.

Total launch range is 18,500 units, reduced to 16,500 after your team's Outer turret is destroyed. Increased impact damage is 180 – 690 (based on level) magic damage.

overflow.name: Overflow
overflow.desc: Your abilities' mana costs are doubled, but you also gain 10% (+ 0.5% per 100 maximum mana) increased damage as well as self and outgoing healing and shielding.

overloaded.name: Overloaded
overloaded.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to have its cooldown reset whenever you cast a different ability.

pandora'sbox.name: Pandora's Box
pandora'sbox.desc: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment. Additionally, your current augments transform into an equal number of completely random Prismatic-tier ones.

patontheback.name: Pat On The Back
patontheback.desc: Whenever you are within 200 units of an allied champion, they pat you on the back, granting you a 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus movement speed) shield and 30% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds (9 second cooldown). Subsequent passes only refresh the duration of the effects.

pentakilldoom.name: Pentakill: DOOM
pentakilldoom.desc: Your champion's ultimate ability gains 20 ability haste and 10% increased damage, healing, and shielding.

pentakillheavy.name: Pentakill: HEAVY
pentakillheavy.desc: Your champion's first basic ability (Q) gains 20 ability haste and 10% increased damage, healing, and shielding.

pentakillpower.name: Pentakill: POWER
pentakillpower.desc: Your champion's second basic ability (W) gains 20 ability haste and 10% increased damage, healing, and shielding.

pentakillthrash.name: Pentakill: THRASH
pentakillthrash.desc: Your champion's third basic ability (E) gains 20 ability haste and 10% increased damage, healing, and shielding.

perseverance.name: Perseverance
perseverance.desc:
Grants 1000% base health regeneration, increased to 2000% while below 25% maximum health.

This augment is currently disabled.

This augment prevents the user from being offered the Vampirism augment.

phenomenalevil.name: Phenomenal Evil
phenomenalevil.desc:
Gain Veigar's Phenomenal Evil Power.

Phenomenal Evil Power: Generate a permanent stack of Phenomenal Evil each time you damage an enemy champion with ability damage. This effect cannot trigger more than once every second globally and once every 3 seconds from the same cast instance. For each stack, gain 1 ability power.

If this is not your first augment, start with 40 Phenomenal Evil stacks, granting you 40 ability power.

The 40 bonus stacks for selecting this augment as not your first augment are given once the first stack is earned.

pincushion.name: Pin Cushion
pincushion.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, empowering it to cause basic attacks during the ability's effect to apply Nail stacks against enemy champions. At the end of the ability's duration, or if you die, the stacks on all targets are consumed, dealing 20 – 60 (based on level) physical damage per Nail stack on the target. If this effect would deal lethal damage to the target, the stacks are consumed immediately. Additionally, once a target's stacks are consumed, you gain 10 bonus movement speed per consumed stack for 3 seconds.

pinball.name: Pinball
pinball.desc:
Your Mark is empowered to instead throw a pinball, which deals 100 – 500 (based on level) bonus true damage and ricochets off of terrain that it collides with. Each time the pinball ricochets, its remaining travel distance is reset, it increases in radius by 25%, deals 20% increased damage, and reduces Mark's remaining cooldown by 30%. The pinball can ricochet up to 4 times, for a maximum radius increase of 100% and a damage increase of 80%. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Poltergeist.

Poltergeist: Casts both Barrier and Ghost on yourself, both lasting 5 seconds and with the former granting a shield for 110 – 440 (based on level) and the latter granting 30% bonus movement speed.

porcupine.name: Porcupine
porcupine.desc: You build up a burst of needles from within you when taking damage from enemy champions, storing up to 400 – 3900 (based on level) pre-mitigation damage taken. After reaching the maximum damage stored, you consume the stored damage to burst the needles outward in a 400 radius, dealing 75 – 200 (based on level) (+ 125% bonus armor) (+ 125% bonus magic resistance) physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

pressurecooker.name: Pressure Cooker
pressurecooker.desc:
Surrounds you in flames, causing you to apply a Burn every second to enemy champions within 300 units for 3 seconds that deals magic damage equal to「 0.5% of your maximum health per second. 」「 1.5% of your maximum health over the duration. 」This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

Additionally, you are assigned with quests that require you to deal a certain amount of damage with the Burn effect against enemy champions. There are three quest tiers, and each completed tier grants you a reward that improves Pressure Cooker's effect.

Tier

Quest

Reward

1

Deal a total of 1500 damage with the Burn.

Increase the Burn's range to 500 units.

2

Deal an additional total of 12,000 damage with the Burn (13,500 damage total).

Double the rate at which the Burn is inflicted, applying two stacks of the effect to targets every second.

3

Deal an additional total of 15,000 damage with the Burn (28,500 damage total).

Increase the Burn's range to 600 units.

promqueen.name: Prom Queen
promqueen.desc:
Automatically cast a modified version of Rakan's The Quickness, empowering you to break into a captivating sprint for 6 seconds. While empowered, you gain ghosting and 50% bonus movement speed, and enemies you collide with are knocked down and become charmed for 1.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).

A sparkly tiara will descend upon you 2.5 seconds before the effect activates.

proteinshake.name: Protein Shake
proteinshake.desc: Gain 25% (+ 35% per 100 bonus armor) (+ 35% per 100 bonus magic resistance) heal and shield power.

puristcaster.name: Purist - Caster
puristcaster.desc: Convert all of your bonus attack speed into ability haste at a rate of 0.65 ability haste per 1% bonus attack speed. Additionally, your abilities' total cooldowns are reduced by 10%.

pursuitofhaste.name: Pursuit of Haste
pursuitofhaste.desc:
Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are two quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with ability haste on the ability.

Tier

Quest

Reward

1

Hit an enemy champion with the ability 10 times.

Reduce the cooldown of the ability equivalent to 80 ability haste.

2

Hit an enemy champion with the ability 20 additional times (30 hits total).

Reduce the cooldown of the ability equivalent to an additional 80 ability haste (160 ability haste total).

pursuitofpower.name: Pursuit of Power
pursuitofpower.desc:
Quest: Hit an enemy champion with a specific ability 10 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the damage of the ability by 30%.

quantumcomputing.name: Quantum Computing
quantumcomputing.desc:
Automatically cast an improved version of Camille's Tactical Sweep when an enemy champion is within 650 units of you, winding up over 0.75 seconds to slash in a 650 radius around you. The slash deals 200 – 350 (based on level) (+ 75% bonus AD) (+ 45% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (30 second cooldown). Enemies hit by the outer edge of the circle take bonus physical damage equal to 10% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 1.6% per 100 AP) (+ 0.1% per 100 bonus health) of their maximum health and are slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds. Additionally, you are healed for 80% of the bonus post-mitigation damage against enemy champions hit by the outer edge.

This augment is currently disabled.

icathia'sfall.name: Quest: Icathia's Fall
icathia'sfall.desc:
Gain Bami's Cinder. You can now purchase Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis in spite of the item limit imposed by Immolate.

Quest: Obtain Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Void Immolation.

While you have Void Immolation, you will be imposed with Immolate's item limit.

When gaining Bami's Cinder, you will lose an Ruby Crystal or a Glowing Mote in your inventory as it will get upgraded with no gold returned back to you.

sneakerhead.name: Quest: Sneakerhead
sneakerhead.desc:
Assigns quests that require you to perform specific tasks while equipped with a particular Boots item, which is granted to you for free during its respective quest. Finish the following quests, which are assigned to you in a random order:

Quest - Berserker's Greaves: Basic attack 25 times.
Quest - Boots of Swiftness: Run 300 steps.
Quest - Ionian Boots of Lucidity: Cast 20 abilities.
Quest - Mercury's Treads: Become afflicted by crowd control 5 times.
Quest - Plated Steelcaps: Reduce a total of 200 damage with Plating.
Quest - Sorcerer's Shoes: Deal a total of 1500 damage with abilities.
Reward: Upon completing all of the above quests, you receive Jarvan I's.

You cannot purchase any Boots items while equipped with this augment. If you already have a Boots item, it is replaced by the Boots granted by this effect. Boots items gained from this effect cannot be sold.

This augment is currently disabled.

steelyourheart.name: Quest: Steel Your Heart
steelyourheart.desc:
Quest: Obtain Heartsteel and accumulate over 300 bonus health from Colossal Consumption.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the bonus health gained from Heartsteel's Colossal Consumption by 200%.

urf'schampion.name: Quest: Urf's Champion
urf'schampion.desc:
Quest: Score 18 champion takedowns.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, you receive The Golden Spatula.

If your inventory is full at the time of quest completion, the item will be granted as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.

The Golden Spatula

Attack damage changed to 90.

Ability power changed to 110.

Attack speed changed to 40%.

Armor changed to 20.

Magic resistance changed to 20.

Movement speed changed to 10%.

Critical strike chance changed to 15%.

Health changed to 200.

Base health regeneration changed to 50%.

Mana changed to 200.

Base mana regeneration changed to 100%.

Life steal changed to 10%.

Unique Passive - Doing Something:

Burn radius changed to 400 units.

Increased mana regeneration changed to 10%.

Increased energy regeneration changed to 20%.

Removed: No longer reduces the remaining cooldowns of your abilities by 0.2 seconds every 0.25 seconds.

wooglet'switchcap.name: Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap
wooglet'switchcap.desc:
Gain a Needlessly Large Rod.

Quest: Obtain Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Wooglet's Witchcap.

Wooglet's Witchcap

Stasis cooldown changed to 60 seconds.

quickstep.name: Quickstep
quickstep.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to cause you to dash up to 350 units towards your cursor.

ravenousbind.name: Ravenous Bind
ravenousbind.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a immobilizing or grounding effect, empowering the ability to deal 15 – 90 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) (+ 0.5% of your maximum health) magic damage to affected targets and heal you for 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 5% AP) (+ 10% bonus health). The heal is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is.

recoil.name: Recoil
recoil.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering it to deal 25% increased damage and on-cast cause you to dash 450 units opposite the direction you are facing.

Dash speed is 1500.

rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
rejuvenation.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to heal you for 30 – 100 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) (+ 5% bonus health). This is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is, for a maximum heal of 45 – 150 (based on level) (+ 37.5% bonus AD) (+ 22.5% AP) (+ 7.5% bonus health).

reload.name: Reload
reload.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, causing basic attacks on-hit during the ability to reduce its remaining cooldown by 0.15 – 0.35 (based on level) seconds.

This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

riteofascension.name: Rite of Ascension
riteofascension.desc: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them causes them to leave behind their Essence for 8 seconds. You can basic attack the Essence within 400 units to consume it: causing you to blink to its location after winding up for 1.25 seconds, during which you are untargetable (except to turrets), displacement immune, and unable to act. Upon consumption of the Essence, you gain 100% bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds, heal yourself for 75 – 300 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP), and reset the cooldowns of your basic abilities. The heal is increased by 0% – 100% (based on your missing health), for a maximum heal of 150 – 600 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP).

salvation.name: Salvation
salvation.desc:
Upon dropping below 50% of your maximum health, you unleash a shockwave that expands from your location over 1200 units, dealing 100 – 500 (based on level) (+ 125% bonus AD) (+ 75% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and healing you and allied champions hit for 200 – 550 (based on level) (+ 200% bonus AD) (+ 120% AP) (90 second cooldown). Enemy champions hit within the first 600 units of the shockwave are knocked back 450 – 100 (based on distance travelled) units.

This effect will still trigger if damage is taken while below 50% maximum health.

sapmagic.name: Sap Magic
sapmagic.desc: Your next basic attack on-hit is empowered to deal 80 – 300 (based on level) (+ 5% bonus health) bonus physical damage and heal you for 50 – 250 (based on level) (+ 8% maximum health) (20 second cooldown). Casting an ability reduces the cooldown of this effect by 3 seconds.

searingdawn.name: Searing Dawn
searingdawn.desc:
Gain Leona's Sunlight.

Sunlight: Your damaging abilities mark enemies, causing them to take 40 – 200 (based on level) bonus magic damage from your ally's next basic attack or ability hit against them (0.75-second cooldown per target).

shadowrunner.name: Shadow Runner
shadowrunner.desc: After dashing, blinking, or exiting stealth, gain 300 bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

sharkbait.name: Shark Bait
sharkbait.desc:
Upon taking fatal damage, you become a Shark Bait, causing you to enter a zombie state for 3.5 seconds, during which your movement speed is set to a static 400, you gain ghosting, and enemies within 400 units of you are slowed by 40%. At the end of the duration, a massive shark emerges from beneath you that lets out a powerful chomp (400 radius), dealing 120 – 350 (based on level) (+ 30% of target's missing health) magic damage to all enemies within the area and knocking them up for 1 second.

While under the zombie state, you are able to move and become invulnerable, untargetable, and immune to crowd control, but you are also rendered unable to declare basic attacks, cast abilities, use summoner spells, and activate items.

sharktempest.name: Shark Tempest
sharktempest.desc:
Your Mark is empowered to circle sharks around it in a 300 radius, dealing 100 – 200 (based on level) magic damage to enemies it passes through as it travels and slowing targets hit by 40% for 1 second. If the missile hits an enemy champion, the sharks circle around their location in a 425 radius instead for 3 seconds, dealing「 30 – 90 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) magic damage every second 」「 90 – 270 (based on level) (+ 75% bonus AD) (+ 45% AP) total magic damage over the duration 」to enemies within the area and slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

The damage dealt by this augment counts as area damage, thus it is able to trigger spell effects.

shrinkengine.name: Shrink Engine
shrinkengine.desc:
Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, gain 8 ability haste and 1% bonus movement speed, and reduce your size by 4%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.

Size reduction is capped at 80% (20 stacks).

shrinkray.name: Shrink Ray
shrinkray.desc: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the target's damage dealt by 15% for 3 seconds, refreshing with each hit. Their size is also reduced significantly for the duration.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to heal you for 30% of its post-mitigation damage dealt to enemy champions.

skilledsniper.name: Skilled Sniper
skilledsniper.desc: Hitting an enemy champion with a basic ability while located at least 600 units away from them at the time of the hit reduces its current cooldown by 80% of its total cooldown, modified to 65% for damage over time abilities.

slaparound.name: Slap Around
slaparound.desc:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 6 bonus Attack Damage or 10 Ability Power (Adaptive), stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Lose 50% of stacks on death.

If the bonus attack damage and the ability power of the unit are equal, the stat granted is always bonus AD.

snapback.name: Snap Back
snapback.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability with a recast. Using the recast causes you to blink back to your original casting position of the ability and explode to deal 100 – 300 (based on level) (+ 20% AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.

This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

snowballupgrade.name: Snowball Upgrade
snowballupgrade.desc:
Your Mark is empowered to hail a snowstorm at the location where the target was hit for 2 seconds, granting sight of the area and dealing「 200 (+ 200% bonus AD) (+ 120% AP) magic damage 」「 25 (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) magic damage every 0.25 seconds 」to enemies within over the duration, as well as slowing them by 50% (+ 6% per 100 AP). Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

This augment is currently disabled.

snowblast.name: Snowblast
snowblast.desc:
Empowers the Dash spell from Mark to deal 100% increased damage and upon arrival cause you to knock up the target for 0.5 seconds and knock back nearby enemies. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

snowday.name: Snowday
snowday.desc:
Your Mark deals 100% increased damage and has its cooldown reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

sonata.name: Sonata
sonata.desc:
Alternate between automatically casting a modified version of Sona's Aria of Perseverance and modified Song of Celerity, with the former being cast first (10 second cooldown).

Aria of Perseverance: Heal yourself for 60 (+ 60% AP) and send out a tone to the most wounded allied champion within 1000 units that heals them for the same amount. Additionally, generate an aura that grants you and tagged allied champions a 80 (+ 40% AP) shield for 1.5 seconds.

Song of Celerity: Gain 30% bonus movement speed for 7 seconds. If you take damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed. Additionally, generate an aura that grants tagged allied champions 20% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds.

sonicboom.name: Sonic Boom
sonicboom.desc: Granting a buff, heal, or shield to your ally deals 30 – 150 (based on level) true damage to enemies within 450 units of them and slows targets by 30% for 2 seconds (2 second cooldown).

souleater.name: Soul Eater
souleater.desc:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 20 bonus health, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance).

If this is not your first augment, gain 300 bonus health.

soulsiphon.name: Soul Siphon
soulsiphon.desc:
Heal for 12% of the post-mitigation damage dealt by your critical strikes. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

Any damage from Critical strikes will heal, including those from non-basic attack sources ( Talon's Noxian Diplomacy, Ashe's Volley, etc).

soundbarrier.name: Sound Barrier
soundbarrier.desc: Your shields on yourself or allies grant ghosting and 20% – 40% (based on level) (+ 0.5% per 1% heal and shield power) bonus movement speed that decays over 1.5 seconds (1.5-second cooldown per target).

spellsplit.name: Spell Split
spellsplit.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a missile, empowering the ability's missile to split in two over 0.25 seconds upon reaching maximum range, or when recast. Each of the split missiles fire perpendicularly in opposite directions and apply the same effects to enemies they hit. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

Recast can be used after 0.15 seconds of the initial cast.

spinmerightround.name: Spin Me Right Round
spinmerightround.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with Akshan's Heroic Swing (10 second cooldown, starts post-effect).

Heroic Swing - Active: You can activate Heroic Swing three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and you can use the third cast only after 0.5 seconds of the second cast. An attack or movement command may be inputted to use the second and third casts.

First Cast: Fire a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first terrain hit for 2 seconds. Heroic Swing's second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or you become immobilized, grounded, or polymorphed within the duration, Heroic Swing is cancelled and placed on full cooldown.

Second Cast: Swing around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to your facing direction, stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, fire at the nearest visible enemy within your attack range (minimum 400 units) every 0.231 seconds to deal them 15 – 75 (based on level) (+ 15% AD) × (1 + 0.3 per 100% bonus attack speed) physical damage and apply on-hit effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness. The dash will be interrupted if you are affected by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.

Third Cast: End the swing by jumping to the target location and fire one last shot at a nearby visible enemy.

spintowin.name: Spin To Win
spintowin.desc:
Your spinning abilities deal 30% increased damage and have their cooldown reduced equivalent to 30 ability haste. The damage amplifier is increased to 50% for ultimate abilities.

This note is not fully complete. If you wish to contribute, please do so on Discussion page

Eligible Abilities: Ahri's Fox-Fire and Spirit Rush, Amumu's Tantrum, Ambessa's Lacerate, Darius' Decimate, Draven's Spinning Axe, Stand Aside, and Whirling Death, Garen's Judgment, Hecarim's Rampage, Jax's Counter Strike, Katarina's Voracity and Death Lotus, Kayn's Reaping Slash, Lillia's Blooming Blows, Nocturne's Umbra Blades, Rammus' Powerball, Renekton's Cull the Meek and Slice and Dice, Rek'Sai's Queen's Wrath, Riven's Broken Wings, Samira's Blade Whirl and Inferno Trigger, Sylas' Petricite Burst, Wukong's Cyclone, Tryndamere's Spinning Slash, Xin Zhao's Crescent Guard, Zed's Shadow Slash

PENDING FOR TEST:: Akshan's Avengerang and Heroic Swing, Lillia's Watch Out! Eep! and Swirlseed, Poppy's Keeper's Verdict, etc.

spiritbomb.name: Spirit Bomb
spiritbomb.desc:
Your healing and shielding on yourself or allies builds up a Spirit Bomb on top of you. Once you have healed and shielded a combined total of 200 – 2000 (based on level), you toss the Spirit Bomb onto the most wounded allied champion over 1.1 seconds. Upon impact, the Spirit Bomb explodes in a 475 radius to heal allied champions within the area for 5% – 15% (based on level) (+ 3% per 100 AP) of their missing health and grants them a shield for 2 seconds that absorbs damage equal to 10% – 25% (based on level) (+ 2% per 100 AP) of their current health.

Healing and shielding from this effect do not count toward the Spirit Bomb's trigger condition.

The toss range for the Spirit Bomb is global; it will target the lowest-health ally on the map.

squishyslappygrab.name: Squishy Slappy Grab
squishyslappygrab.desc: When an enemy champion is within 450 units of you, after a 1.5-second delay, you send out Squishy Slappy Hands that latch onto all nearby enemy champions within 800 units, forming a tether between yourself and each target for 4 seconds (30 second cooldown). While the tethers persist (950 tether radius), your next basic attack is empowered to pull all tethered enemies toward you, dealing 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 15% bonus health) magic damage to affected targets and stunning them for 0.25 seconds after the pull ends. Targets are pulled over 450 units, reduced to 350 for those farther away from you. Additionally, you gain a 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus armor) (+ 50% bonus magic resistance) shield for each pulled enemy, lasting for 2.5 seconds.

stackosaurusrex.name: Stackosaurus Rex
stackosaurusrex.desc: Increase the number of permanent stacks you gain from abilities by 100%.

statsonstatsonstats.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
statsonstatsonstats.desc: Gain 4 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils. Additionally, on the next round of augment selection, you gain an additional reroll per augment slot.

statsonstats.name: Stats on Stats!
statsonstats.desc: Gain 3 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils.

stayresolute.name: Stay Resolute
stayresolute.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to grant you 1 / 2 / 3 (based on level) bonus armor or bonus magic resistance permanently when it damages an enemy champion, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per target per cast instance).

The resistance type granted is based on the target's adaptive type: bonus armor for physical and bonus magic resistance for magic.

If this is not your first augment, gain 20 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance.

stillhere.name: Still Here
stillhere.desc: Gain 0% – 200% (based on your missing health) bonus attack speed and 0% – 35% (based on your missing health) life steal.

stuckinherewithme.name: Stuck in Here With Me
stuckinherewithme.desc:
Casting your ultimate ability grants you an aura for 2 seconds, growing in size over the duration to up to 500 units. After the duration, you taunt all enemies within the aura for 2 seconds and gain 50% damage reduction for the same duration (30 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.

Aura is activated once the ultimate's effect starts or has elapsed.

On Katarina, this augment will activate at the start of Death Lotus' channel.

surgefield.name: Surge Field
surgefield.desc:
Upon casting your ultimate ability, you spawn a surge zone beneath you that has a 300 radius. While you are within the zone, you gain 50 ability haste and 40% bonus movement speed, and your damage dealt to enemy champions fires missiles at them that deal 20% of the triggering damage instance pre-mitigation as bonus magic damage. The missile effect cannot trigger from itself.

The zone lasts indefinitely as long as you stay within its radius. If you leave the zone's radius for the first time, it moves to your current location. Exiting the zone a second time causes it to disappear if you do not re-enter the area within 1.25 seconds.

swiftandsafe.name: Swift and Safe
swiftandsafe.desc: After dashing or blinking, gain a shield that lasts for 2 seconds and absorbs 65 – 290 (based on level) (+ 65% AD) (+ 26% AP) damage (5 second cooldown).

symphonyofwar.name: Symphony of War
symphonyofwar.desc:
Gain the Conqueror and Lethal Tempo keystone runes.

Conqueror

Adaptive force per stack changed to 1.8 – 3.3 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 3 – 5.5 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive).

Healing changed to ( 10% / 8%) of damage dealt.

Lethal Tempo

Bonus attack speed per stack changed to ( 13% – 18% / 8% – 12%) (based on level).

Maximum bonus attack speed changed to ( 78% – 108% / 48% – 72%) (based on level).

Removed: No longer empowers basic attacks at maximum stacks to fire a bolt that deals bonus adaptive damage.

New Effect: At maximum stacks, gain 50 bonus attack range and increase the attack speed cap to 10.

take'emdowndowndown.name: Take'em Down Down Down
take'emdowndowndown.desc:
Basic attacks on-hit and ability hits against enemy champions apply a stack for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 5 times, and deal ( 5 – 30 / 2.5 – 15) (based on level) (+ ( 35% / 17.5%) bonus AD) (+ ( 15% / 7.5%) AP) bonus magic damage plus ( 1 – 6 / 0.5 – 3) (based on level) (+ ( 7% / 3.5%) bonus AD) (+ ( 3% / 1.5%) AP) additional magic damage per stack on the target.

The fifth stack against a target consumes them all to deal additional magic damage equal to ( 15% / 7.5%) (+ ( 5% / 2.5%) total bonus attack speed) (+ ( 1.5% / 0.75%) per 10 ability haste) of the target's missing health and heal you for ( 67% / 33.5%) of the post-mitigation damage dealt.

tankengine.name: Tank Engine
tankengine.desc: Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, increase your maximum health and size by 5%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.

tankitorleaveit.name: Tank It Or Leave It
tankitorleaveit.desc:
Gain Critical Defend Chance equal to 100% critical strike chance, up to 50%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

Critical Defend Chance: Grants you a chance to reduce an instance of damage taken by 20% (5 second cooldown per enemy spell cast instance).

tapdancer.name: Tap Dancer
tapdancer.desc: Basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions and minions grant 10 bonus movement speed, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking infinitely. Additionally, gain bonus attack speed equal to 10% total movement speed.

terrain'd.name: Terrain'd
terrain'd.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that spawns terrain, empowering the ability to deal 20 – 180 (based on level) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies near the terrain. This damage is increased「 by 200% 」「 to 60 – 540 (based on level) (+ 60% AP) 」if the ability is an ultimate.

The damage dealt by this augment counts as area damage, thus it is able to trigger spell effects.

terror.name: Terror
terror.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to fear all enemies within 450 units of you for 1.75 seconds (30 second cooldown).

theboomandthebass.name: The Boom and the Bass
theboomandthebass.desc: After casting an ability, your next basic attack within 6 seconds is empowered to gain 200% bonus attack speed, deal ( 50 – 200 / 25 – 100) (based on level) (+ ( 50% / 25%) bonus AD) (+ ( 30% / 15%) AP) bonus magic damage, and grant you 75% – 150% (based on level) bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds.

thirdtimestheharm.name: Third Times the Harm
thirdtimestheharm.desc: Your basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions apply a mark to the target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. Every third attack against the marked target grants you a stack and deals bonus true damage equal to ( 6% / 3%) of the target's maximum health (+ ( 10 / 5) per stack you have).

threadtheneedle.name: Thread the Needle
threadtheneedle.desc: Grants 18% armor penetration and magic penetration.

ticklemonster.name: Tickle Monster
ticklemonster.desc: Convert all of your bonus attack damage into bonus attack speed at a rate of 1.75% bonus attack speed per 1 bonus attack damage. Additionally, your basic attacks deal 5 – 50 (based on level) bonus magic damage on-hit.

titan'sresolve.name: Titan's Resolve
titan'sresolve.desc:
You generate a stack of Juggernauting for each instance of damage you deal or take (excluding damage over time), lasting for 6 seconds and refreshing on subsequent damage dealt or taken. For every 10 stacks of Juggernauting, you gain 15 – 45 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 25 – 75 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive), 5 – 10 (based on level) bonus armor and bonus magic resistance, 10% increased size, and 8% tenacity.

Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends, with the decay rate being faster the more stacks you have.

toothfairy.name: Tooth Fairy
toothfairy.desc: When you deal post-mitigation damage to an enemy champion equal to or more than 25% of their maximum health within 2.5 seconds, they drop a Tooth on the ground (4 second cooldown per target). You can pick up this Tooth by moving over it, granting you a Dental Records stack. For each stack, you gain 3 lethality and flat magic penetration.

totentanz.name: Totentanz
totentanz.desc:
Replace a summoner spell with A Dance with Death.

A Dance with Death: Enter a contract with death for 6 seconds, opening a rift to the underworld beneath you and chaining you to it for the duration, during which you are also invulnerable and gain a minimum health threshold equal to 25 health. Over the first second, you become displacement immune and unable to act, and afterwards blink in the target direction. For the remaining duration, you are inflicted with a health threshold equal to 100% – 1% (based on seconds elapsed) of your maximum health. If your current health is above the threshold at each interval, it is reduced to the maximum health ratio of the threshold.

If you score a takedown against a champion within 3 seconds of damaging them before the end of the duration, your contract is fulfilled and this effect ends. The health threshold is removed, you are healed for 250 – 1000 (based on level) (+ 10 per 1 lethality) (+ 10 per 1 flat magic penetration), you blink back to the rift's location, the rift closes, and A Dance with Death's current cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds. Otherwise, if the duration expires, you fail your contract and are dragged into the rift, where you are executed upon arrival.

The health threshold cannot be modified nor exceeded by any means.

The pull towards the rift is a forced displacement.

While being pulled into the rift, the champion is rendered untargetable and unable to act.

transmutechaos.name: Transmute: Chaos
transmutechaos.desc: Gain two completely random augments, excluding the other two offerings in your current assortment.

triggeredinferno.name: Triggered Inferno
triggeredinferno.desc:
Your damaging basic attacks and abilities against at least one enemy champion unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a stack of Style for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 7 times. For each stack, gain 4.25% / 4.5% / 4.75% / 5% (based on level) bonus movement speed, up to a maximum of 29.75% / 31.5% / 33.25% / 35% (based on level).

Upon reaching maximum Style stacks, if an enemy champion is within range, you unleash a torrent of shots for 2.277 seconds. Over the first 2.013 seconds, you rapidly shoot at enemies within 600 units at sporadic times in 0.2-second intervals each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing 20 – 40 (based on level) (+ 40% AD) (+ 25% AP) physical damage with each shot, reduced by 75% against minions. Enemies below 30% of their maximum health are critically struck for「 double damage 」「 40 – 80 (based on level) (+ 80% AD) (+ 50% AP) physical damage 」(5 second cooldown). This effect ends prematurely if you become affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

Style stacks are represented by grades (→→→→→→). The stacks are consumed at the end of the shooting effect. Shot damage applies life steal.

The Style stack count and corresponding symbol letter (see above) is indicated underneath your champion's model.

Samira cannot use Inferno Trigger during Triggered Inferno

tripleshot.name: Tripleshot
tripleshot.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that is unit-targeted and fires a missile, empowering the ability to fire its missiles at two additional enemies near the primary target. Subsequent hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

trustyweapon.name: Trusty Weapon
