trustyweapon.desc: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to generate a Friendship stack for 6 seconds when it hits an enemy champion. For each Friendship stack you have, the ability deals 5% increased damage. This effect can stack up to a number of times.

twinfire.name: Twin Fire
twinfire.desc: Damaging abilities against enemy champions launch 1 (+ 1 per 33.33% critical strike chance) missiles at the target that each deal 10 – 30 (based on level) (+ 7% bonus AD) (+ 7% AP) magic damage (5 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

typhoon.name: Typhoon
typhoon.desc: Basic attacks launch a missile at a nearby enemy, prioritizing champions, that deals 30% AD physical damage and applies on-hit effects.

ultimateawakening.name: Ultimate Awakening
ultimateawakening.desc: Casting your ultimate ability resets the cooldowns of all your basic abilities and grants you 300 basic ability haste for 15 seconds (20 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.

ultimaterevolution.name: Ultimate Revolution
ultimaterevolution.desc: Casting your ultimate ability resets its cooldown once its effect starts or has elapsed (75 second cooldown, reset upon death).

ultimateunstoppable.name: Ultimate Unstoppable
ultimateunstoppable.desc: Casting your ultimate ability grants you crowd control immunity for 3 seconds (8 second cooldown).

ultrahydra.name: Ultra Hydra
ultrahydra.desc:
You can now purchase Tiamat, Profane Hydra, Ravenous Hydra, and Titanic Hydra in spite of the item limit imposed by Hydra. Purchasing a Legendary-tier Hydra item (excluding Stridebreaker) grants you a Tiamat for free.

Quest: Obtain Profane Hydra, Ravenous Hydra, and Titanic Hydra.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Ultra Hydra.

While you have Ultra Hydra, you will be imposed with Hydra's item limit.

Hydra items cannot be sold while equipped with this augment.

upgradecollector.name: Upgrade Collector
upgradecollector.desc: Upgrades The Collector, empowering Death to have its execution threshold increased by 0.5% each time you kill an enemy champion, capped at a threshold of 12.5% of the target's maximum health, and Taxes to generate a further 25 (total 50) from kills. Additionally, gain 250.

upgradedeath'sdance.name: Upgrade Death's Dance
upgradedeath'sdance.desc: Upgrades Death's Dance, empowering Ignore Pain with an increased damage reduction of ( 40% / 15%) and Defy with an increased heal AD ratio of 125% bonus AD. Defy's healing is also granted instantly upon the passive effect being triggered rather than over 2 seconds. Additionally, gain 250.

upgradeimmolate.name: Upgrade Immolate
upgradeimmolate.desc:
Upgrades Bami's Cinder, Hollow Radiance, Sunfire Aegis, and Void Immolation, empowering Immolate to additionally grant you 12 per tick for each enemy champion afflicted by its effect. Additionally, gain 250.

Clones do not count as valid targets for the effect.

upgradeinfinityedge.name: Upgrade Infinity Edge
upgradeinfinityedge.desc:
Upgrades Infinity Edge, empowering it to gain Sword of the Divine's Excoriate. Additionally, gain 500.

Excoriate: Gain a random amount of bonus critical strike damage that scales up to 50% of your critical strike chance, with the value of this amount changing every 0.25 seconds.

upgraderavenoushydra.name: Upgrade Ravenous Hydra
upgraderavenoushydra.desc: Upgrades Ravenous Hydra, increasing its life steal stat to 20% and empowering Cleave to trigger its effect on ability hits against enemies (1 second cooldown per ability). Additionally, gain 500.

upgradesheen.name: Upgrade Sheen
upgradesheen.desc: Upgrades all Spellblade items, empowering the passive effect to deal additional bonus physical damage equal to 4% of the target's maximum health and heal you for 3.5% of the target's maximum health. Additionally, gain 250.

upgradestormsurge.name: Upgrade Stormsurge
upgradestormsurge.desc:
Upgrades Stormsurge, empowering Squall to strike the area around the target with lightning (350 radius) after its delay, dealing magic damage equal to 10% (+ 2% per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health to enemies hit. Enemy champions hit by the blast are also inflicted with Squall, causing them to also be struck with the same lightning after the delay and apply Squall to other enemy champions hit by their blast that were not already afflicted. Additionally, gain 500.

Squall's electric field from the target dying before the lightning strike also applies this augment's effects.

upgradesunderedsky.name: Upgrade Sundered Sky
upgradesunderedsky.desc: Upgrades Sundered Sky, empowering Lightshield Strike with an increased heal health ratio of 9% of your missing health and a reduced cooldown of 5 seconds. Additionally, gain 500.

upgradeswordofblossomingdawn.name: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn
upgradeswordofblossomingdawn.desc: Upgrades Sword of Blossoming Dawn, empowering Peppermint to have its healing increased by 250%. Additionally, you gain 100% bonus attack speed.

upgradezhonya's.name: Upgrade Zhonya's
upgradezhonya's.desc:
Upgrades Seeker's Armguard, Wooglet's Witchcap, and Zhonya's Hourglass, empowering Stasis to cleanse you of all crowd control and allow you to move during its active effect, during which time you also gain 50% bonus movement speed. Additionally, the cooldown of Zhonya's Hourglass' Stasis is reduced to 45 seconds.

The active cannot be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control despite cleansing the user.

vampirism.name: Vampirism
vampirism.desc:
You can no longer be healed by allies and your health regeneration is set to 0. Gain 25% omnivamp.

This augment is currently disabled.

Diadem of Songs' Consonance and Moonstone Renewer's Starlit Grace will specifically not target champions with this augment.

This augment prevents the user from being offered the Perseverance augment.

This augment is not offered if the champion has built Warmog's Armor.

veilofwarding.name: Veil of Warding
veilofwarding.desc: Grants a spell shield that blocks the next hostile ability (30 second cooldown, timer does not restart from champion damage taken).

voiddash.name: Void Dash
voiddash.desc:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a dash, empowering the ability to spawn a void zone (250 radius) at the dash's destination after a 0.3-second delay. Enemy champions within the zone are dealt 80 – 400 (based on level) (+ 100% ability haste) magic damage and are slowed by 35% for 1 second.

This augment is currently disabled.

vulnerability.name: Vulnerability
vulnerability.desc:
Damage dealt by items and damage over time effects can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical strike damage) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).

The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects.

weaponofdestiny.name: Weapon of Destiny
weaponofdestiny.desc:
Upon acquiring this augment, the first eligible Legendary item in your inventory is granted the Weapon of Destiny passive effect.

Weapon of Destiny: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them permanently increases the gold value of all upgradeable stats on this item by exactly 200, shared equally among them. This item can no longer be sold.

Weapon of Destiny scans each item slot in your inventory (from slots 1-6) for an eligible Legendary item, granting the passive effect to the first eligible item that is found.

Statistics' gold value and eligible stats to be increased for the item:

40 per 1 point of ability haste.

50 per 1 point of ability power.

30 per 1 point of attack damage.

40 per 1% of attack speed.

50 per 1 point of armor.

50 per 1 point of magic resistance.

25 per 1% of critical strike chance.

165 per 1% of critical strike damage.

35 per 1 point of lethality.

25 per 1 point of flat magic penetration.

25 per 1% of percentage armor penetration.

15 per 1% of percentage magic penetration.

25 per 1% of life steal.

25 per 1% of omnivamp.

15 per 1% of percentage movement speed.

20 per 1% of heal and shield power.

1 point of health has a variable gold value, based on the number of upgradeable stats that exist on the item:

If health is the item's only upgradeable stat, it receives +375 health and health is valued at 2.6 per point.

If the item has health and only one other upgradeable stat, it receives +185 health and health is valued at 2.702 per point.

If the item has health and two other upgradeable stats, it receives +125 health and health is valued at 2.6 per point.

If the item has health and three other upgradeable stats, it receives +90 health and health is valued at 2.7 per point.

1 point of mana has a variable gold value, based on the number of upgradeable stats that exist on the item:

If mana is the item's only upgradeable stat, it receives +200 mana and mana is valued at 1 per point.

If the item has mana and only one other upgradeable stat, it receives +100 mana and mana is valued at 2 per point.

If the item has mana and two other upgradeable stats, it receives +67 mana and mana is valued at 3 per point.

If the item has mana and three other upgradeable stats, it receives +50 mana and mana is valued at 4 per point.

The stat increases are rounded down (any decimal values are lost).

weewooweewoo.name: Wee Woo Wee Woo
weewooweewoo.desc: Gain 0% – 50% (based on target ally's missing health) bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby allied champions, lingering for 2 seconds after no longer facing them. Your heals and shields are also increased by 0% – 50% (based on target's missing health).

windspeaker'sblessing.name: Windspeaker's Blessing
windspeaker'sblessing.desc: Your heals and shields on yourself or allies grant the target 30 – 60 (based on level) bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 3 seconds.

withhaste.name: With Haste
withhaste.desc: Grants bonus movement speed equal to 70% ability haste.

yowchmycoins.name: Yowch, My Coins!
yowchmycoins.desc: Enemy champions that you score a takedown against drop 6 – 10 (based on level) coins, with each coin landing 500 units away from the location of their death and lasting 10 seconds. You or allied champions can collect the coins by moving over them, granting 15 for each coin collected.

zealot.name: Zealot
zealot.desc: Gain 35% (+ 5% per 100 AP) bonus attack speed and 25% (+ 5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance.
